mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.CONTENT AS content, P.TITLE AS postTitle, P.BOARD_ID AS boardId, B.BOARD_NAME AS boardName, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN POST P ON C.POST_ID = P.POST_ID JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON P.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0 ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.TITLE AS title, P.BOARD_ID AS boardId, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKE PL WHERE PL.POST_ID = P.POST_ID) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_COMMENT PC WHERE PC.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0) AS commentCount FROM POST_LIKE L JOIN POST P ON L.POST_ID = P.POST_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_BLIND = 0 ORDER BY L.PRESSED_AT DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS tradeId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS status, '판매' AS role, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS tradeId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS status, '구매' AS role, MIN(T.CREATED_AT) AS createdAt FROM TRADE_CHAT_ROOM T JOIN PRODUCT P ON T.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE T.BUYER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRICE, P.PRODUCT_STATUS ) ORDER BY createdAt DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS price, P.PLACE AS place, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS status FROM PRODUCT_LIKE L JOIN PRODUCT P ON L.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE L.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY L.PRESSED_AT DESC
